title: prompts/ corpus: operator-pointed prompts + dispatched-agent lenses
content: `prompts/` is the home for checked-in prose prompts an agent is pointed at: operator-pointed prompts at the root, dispatched-agent lenses under `prompts/agents/` (so brofiles stay thin pointers). Distinct from `system-defaults/` (installable JSON artifacts) and `.claude` skills (harness-native commands). Index: `prompts/README.md`.
